Natural language explanations (NLEs) that link a radiographic finding to its evidence, including location, size, severity, certainty, and differential diagnoses.

guideline: Radiologists rated correctness on a 7-point Likert scale; study participants rated perceived usefulness via 'How useful was the AI model's explanation in helping you decide whether the AI was right or wrong in suggesting [finding].'

Participants rated the usefulness of each explanation on a 7‑point Likert scale and indicated their agreement with the AI advice (Not present / Maybe present / Definitely present). Radiologists rated explanation correctness on a 7‑point Likert scale.

Annotators were asked to rate explanation correctness on a 7-point Likert scale, with different prompts depending on whether the AI advice was correct or incorrect. For correct AI advice: 'How correctly does the NLE (or heatmap) explain the AI advice pneumonia in this image?' For incorrect AI advice: 'How correctly does the heatmap (or NLE) highlight radiographic findings that would be relevant for the AI advice pneumonia in this image?'
